messages.subject: Mis match in INLA Graph
parts:
I have the code below, i have created an adjacency matrix and specified the column to be used


polygons=readShapePoly("polygons.shp")
temp <- poly2nb(polygons,queen=TRUE, row.names=polygons$ID)
nb2INLA("KEN.adj", temp ) 
g=inla.read.graph("KEN.adj")
plot(g)

However, when I plot g, or view the which polygons is a neighbor of which, the IDs do not match those in the shapefiles. 

What i am doing wrong here?
